title: Gauss-Green identity for the blow-ups η_{x,r}(E) (Simon (8); parent Part 1b)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, E ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable, (μ, ν) a Gauss-Green pair for (U, E) (IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν), x ∈ ℝ^N and r > 0, and let η := η_{x,r} = blowUpMap x r, η(y) = r⁻¹(y − x). Then for every C¹ map g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ η(U): ∫_{η(E)} div g dL^N = −(rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫ ⟨g(η(y)), ν(y)⟩ dμ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)) (x : Rn (n + 1)) (r : ℝ), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → 0 < r → ∀ g : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ blowUpMap x r '' U → ∫ z in blowUpMap x r '' E, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g z = -((r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, inner ℝ (g (blowUpMap x r y)) (ν y) ∂μ)
